title: Trigger
description: A trigger; also the record of a condition (only type/param are used).

id.description: the record's own id (the trigger table entry)

children.description: raw nodes kept in this file

$schema.description: path or URL of this schema

extends.description: the object this one overrides (README §10.3); fields left out, and the hidden ones, come from it

param.description: parameters, passed to the test (TAC_PARAMS_TRIGGER_* below)

paramWords.description: never read; the words of `param` (as TriggerAction.paramWords)

state.description: TRIGGER_STATE_*, set at run time; 0 in every pack

Trigger.description: A trigger; also the record of a condition (only type/param are used).

param.description: parameters, passed to the test (TAC_PARAMS_TRIGGER_* below)

TriggerAction.title: TriggerAction
TriggerAction.description: An action record. The pack's record is queued itself, so `count` and `delay` change as it runs (Trigger_SaveActions/RestoreActions keep the counts across a round reset).

paramWords.description: never read; the words of `data` as the exporter counted them: equal, or off by a constant per kind (+1 for a keyword and a list), in every pack (tools/xdl_tac.py)

count.description: times it can still run, 0xFFFFFFFF: always

delay.description: ms left before it runs; = delayInit in every pack

tail.description: what follows the list in its node, kept as it was: hex, or words when it holds links
